en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a large white building complex with red tiled roofs, surrounded by trees and a low white fence. The main structure has multiple small dormer windows and green shutters, with a smaller pavilion-like building in front. A sandy or grassy open area is visible in the foreground. At the top left of the image is the printed caption "Waldschänke Hellerau." in red letters.
